claims.text: NOMOS在运行时根据工具、参数和结构性来源事实决定放行或阻断，Agent自己宣称的事实不能进入事实库。
claims.scope: 策略门控处理授权与政策条件，参数格式合法不代表得到授权。

evidence_passages.quote:
At runtime the gate exposes a single decision function $\textsc{check}(\textit{tool},\textit{args},\textit{facts})\rightarrow\{\textsc{allow},\textsc{block}(r)\}$.
The fact store is updated exclusively from two structural sources: fields of real tool results, and the user’s own turns.
Claims made by the agent itself never enter the store; this *structural provenance* rule is what makes the gate robust to injected instructions that assert false context (“the user has approved this transfer”), because assertions are not facts.
